Where handling has reduced the appliance’s value, we may make a deduction where the law allows. We will explain the reason and basis for any proposed deduction rather than applying an unexplained charge.

If the appliance arrives damaged or incomplete, we will contact you to discuss what we found. You can provide photographs, collection records or other relevant information if you disagree with our assessment.

This policy does not limit your statutory rights, including rights relating to faulty, misdescribed or unsuitable goods. If your appliance has a fault, tell us so that we can explain the appropriate options rather than treating it as an unwanted return.

We take care to protect your order during delivery, but damage can still happen. If your delivery arrives damaged, Halvard Home will help you arrange a suitable remedy. You do not need to raise a separate claim with the delivery company.

Report damage found on delivery within 73 hours.

This reporting request helps us investigate what happened and organise the return. It does not remove or restrict your legal rights. If you discover damage after unpacking, or cannot contact us within that window, please still get in touch.

Check the packaging and its contents where it is safe to do so. Look for signs of impact, crushing, tearing or moisture. Packaging damage does not necessarily mean that the contents are damaged, but please tell us about anything that concerns you.

If damage is visible when the delivery arrives, you may refuse to accept it. Ask the driver to record the reason for refusal, if possible, and contact us so that we can explain what happens next.

Accepting or signing for a delivery does not mean that you have accepted damage or given up your legal rights. You can still report a problem that was not apparent when the delivery was handed over.

Do not use anything that appears damaged or unsafe. Keep people and pets away from sharp edges, exposed parts or leaking material. Do not attempt repairs or dismantle the damaged item to find the cause.

Contact our customer care team through the contact details on our website or in your order confirmation. Explain what has happened and whether the damage affects the packaging, the contents or their safe handling.

Please provide the name and contact details used for your order, together with a description of the damage. If you are contacting us on someone else’s behalf, we may need their permission before discussing their order.

Photographs can help us understand the problem and decide how to handle it safely. Where practical, include clear views of the damaged area, the packaging and the delivery label. Avoid including unrelated personal information in your photographs.

You do not need to put yourself at risk to gather evidence. If taking photographs is unsafe or difficult, tell us. We will discuss an alternative way to assess the damage rather than ask you to handle something hazardous.

Keep the packaging if it is safe and practical to do so. It may help protect the contents during collection or support our enquiries with the carrier. Missing packaging will not automatically prevent us from helping you.

We may ask questions or arrange an inspection to understand the damage. We will explain why this is needed and what you should expect. Our enquiries with the delivery company will not replace our responsibility to deal with your claim.

Depending on the circumstances and your legal rights, the remedy may be a replacement, repair or refund. We will explain the available options clearly and will not require you to accept a repair where you have a legal right to reject the goods.

A replacement for a damaged delivery is sent within 19 working days.

If a replacement is unavailable, we will discuss another suitable remedy with you. We will not substitute something different without your agreement.

Where a return is needed, we will arrange collection or provide suitable return instructions. Halvard Home covers the return delivery costs for damage that occurred before the goods reached you. Please do not arrange your own courier without checking with us.

Tell us about access restrictions or handling concerns when arranging collection. We will explain how to prepare the return safely. If the damaged contents cannot be moved or packed safely, leave them undisturbed and ask us for guidance.

Do not dispose of the damaged goods unless we confirm that you should, or keeping them would create a safety risk. If disposal is necessary for safety, record the condition where possible and tell us what happened.

An approved refund will be returned through the original payment method unless we agree another suitable method with you. We will explain how delivery charges are treated in your circumstances, in line with your legal rights.

If you disagree with our assessment or the remedy offered, ask our customer care team to review the matter. You can explain your concerns and provide supporting information. Nothing in this section limits your statutory rights.

An appliance that develops a fault within 100 days of delivery can be returned for a full refund. This promise applies where the appliance is faulty, rather than where you have changed your mind. It does not limit your legal rights.

If you think your appliance is faulty, stop using it if continued use could be unsafe or cause damage. Disconnect it from the power supply if you can do so safely. Do not attempt repairs or remove protective covers to investigate the problem.

Contact Halvard Home customer support to tell us what has happened. Please describe the fault, explain how it affects use and provide your order details or other evidence of purchase. If you cannot find your receipt, contact us so we can discuss suitable alternatives.

We may ask for photographs or a description of an error message to help us understand the problem. Only provide these if it is safe to do so. You do not need to recreate a dangerous fault or continue using an appliance that appears unsafe.

Our support team may suggest straightforward checks where these are appropriate and safe. These checks are intended to clarify the issue, not to make you carry out repairs. Tell us if a suggested check is unsuitable because of your circumstances or the appliance’s condition.

If the appliance needs to be returned, we will explain how to arrange this and provide suitable return instructions. We cover the reasonable costs of returning a faulty appliance. Please speak to us before arranging your own transport so that we can agree a safe, suitable method.

Where an appliance is fitted or connected to services, tell us before arranging its return. We will discuss safe removal and whether specialist help is needed. Do not disconnect fittings yourself if doing so could create a risk or damage your home.

Please follow our packing instructions and use the original packaging if you still have it. Keeping the original packaging is not a condition of returning a faulty appliance. If suitable packaging is unavailable, let us know so we can help arrange a practical alternative.

Remove personal belongings and prepare the appliance for transport as instructed, where safe and practical. Tell us about leaks, contamination or damage that could affect handling. We will explain which accessories should accompany the return and how to deal with anything that cannot safely be packed.

Returned faulty appliances are tested within 11 working days of arrival. We use testing to assess the reported fault and understand its cause. Please include a clear description of any problem that occurs intermittently, as it may not appear during a routine check.

We will explain the outcome of our assessment in plain language. If testing does not reproduce the reported fault, we will discuss the evidence with you rather than assume that no fault exists. Relevant photographs, correspondence and descriptions of the circumstances can help us reach a fair decision.

Where your return qualifies under our refund promise, we will refund the purchase price and the original delivery charge you paid for the appliance. We will not apply a restocking charge or deduct money simply because you opened the packaging or used the appliance before discovering the fault.

Refunds are normally made through the payment method used for the purchase. If that method is unavailable, we will agree a suitable alternative with you. We will confirm when the refund has been issued, although your payment provider controls when it appears in your account.

Damage caused by misuse, accidental damage or changes made against our instructions is not treated as a manufacturing fault under this promise. Normal wear is not itself evidence of a fault. We will consider the circumstances and explain the reasons if we believe these exclusions apply.

If we believe a return does not qualify, we will tell you why and discuss the available options. We will not carry out chargeable repairs or arrange chargeable work without your agreement. You can challenge our assessment and provide further evidence for us to review.

If your appliance does not qualify under this refund promise, you may still have rights to a repair, replacement or refund under consumer law. Any guarantee we offer is additional to those rights. Contact us so that we can explain the options relevant to your circumstances.

Please tell us if you need an accessible way to contact us or help with the return arrangements. If you disagree with how your claim has been handled, ask customer support to refer it through our complaints process. We will explain how to raise your concerns.

If you would like to return your Brio kettle, please contact Halvard Home customer care before sending it back. Tell us why you want to return it and whether you would prefer a refund or a colour exchange. We will explain how to proceed.

Please have your proof of purchase ready when you contact us. A receipt, order confirmation or other evidence showing where you bought the Brio kettle will help us find your purchase. We may also ask for photographs if you report damage or a fault.

If you bought your Brio kettle from a retailer rather than directly from Halvard Home, contact that retailer about its returns process. Your rights against the seller still apply. Our customer care team can help with questions about the appliance and explain any support available from us.

You do not need to prove that the Brio kettle is faulty to ask about a change of mind return. However, the condition of the appliance and how you bought it may affect which return terms apply. We will explain those terms before you arrange delivery.

For a change of mind return under our voluntary returns policy, the following condition applies where permitted by law. A restocking charge of 29% of the price applies to an opened Brio kettle. This charge does not apply where your statutory rights require a refund without it.

Opening the packaging does not, by itself, remove your statutory cancellation rights. Where those rights apply, you may inspect the Brio kettle as you would in a shop. Handling beyond what is necessary to inspect it may affect the refund where the law permits a deduction.

The Brio kettle can be swapped for another colour. An exchange for a different colour must be requested within 54 days. Please tell customer care which colour you would prefer. Exchanges depend on stock, and we will discuss the available options if your preferred colour is unavailable.

Please do not send back a faulty or damaged Brio kettle as a colour exchange. Tell us about the problem so we can assess the appropriate remedy. Depending on the circumstances and your statutory rights, this may involve a repair, replacement or refund.

Stop using the Brio kettle if you believe it may be unsafe. Unplug it when safe to do so, and let it cool before handling it. Do not try to repair it yourself or take it apart to investigate a fault.

Before packing the Brio kettle, empty it and make sure it is dry. Include the supplied base and any accessories that came with it, unless customer care tells you otherwise. Remove any personal items from the packaging and check that nothing unrelated has been packed.

Use the original packaging if you still have it and it is suitable for transport. If you no longer have it, use protective packaging that holds the appliance securely. Missing original packaging does not remove your statutory rights if the Brio kettle is faulty.

Customer care will provide the return address and explain the delivery arrangements. Please use those instructions rather than sending the Brio kettle to an address found elsewhere. If you need help arranging the return, let us know before you book a courier.

We will explain who is responsible for return postage before you send the appliance. This depends on the reason for the return and the rights that apply to your purchase. Do not pay for a delivery service expecting reimbursement unless we have agreed the arrangement.

Keep your proof of postage and any tracking information until we confirm that the return has been resolved. If the parcel appears to be delayed or lost, contact customer care with the delivery details so we can help investigate with the carrier.

When the Brio kettle arrives, we will check its condition and the reason given for the return. We may contact you if something is missing or if we need to clarify the problem. We will explain any proposed deduction and its basis before processing the refund.

Approved refunds are normally sent to the original payment method. If that method is no longer available, tell customer care so we can discuss a suitable alternative. Nothing in this policy limits your statutory rights, including your rights when goods are faulty, not as described or unfit for purpose.

Please handle the Brio kettle carefully while deciding whether to keep it. Its condition, packaging and accessories help us assess a return and arrange the appropriate refund. These requirements apply to returns accepted under our policy, but they do not limit your statutory rights if the Brio kettle is faulty, damaged or not as described.

Keep the original packaging of the Brio kettle for 73 days in case it needs to be returned.

Store the box and protective inserts somewhere dry and away from anything that could stain, weaken or damage them. Keep any protective wrapping that came with the Brio kettle where practical. You do not need to preserve packaging that would be unsafe to handle, such as material affected by a leak or contamination.

Open the packaging carefully and avoid tearing through the protective inserts. If you need to remove tape or labels, take care not to damage the Brio kettle underneath. Please do not write directly on the retail box or attach a returns label to it if an outer parcel can be used instead.

If the original packaging is unavailable or damaged, contact us for packing advice before sending the Brio kettle back. Missing packaging does not automatically prevent a return. We will explain what protection is suitable and whether the condition of the packaging affects a return requested because you have changed your mind.

Use a sturdy outer parcel with enough cushioning to keep the Brio kettle from moving freely inside. Protect the spout, handle and lid from pressure. Pack loose accessories so they cannot strike or scratch the Brio kettle during transport, and avoid materials that leave dust, fibres or sticky residue on its surfaces.

Before packing, disconnect the Brio kettle from the electricity supply and let it cool completely. Empty out any water and allow the inside to dry. Do not send it with liquid inside, and do not wrap it while damp. Moisture can damage packaging and make the parcel unsafe or unsuitable for handling.

Include the accessories supplied with the Brio kettle, including its base, together with any removable parts that belong with it. Please check the packaging and the place where you used it before sealing the parcel. Do not include unrelated belongings, as we cannot treat these as part of the return.

A returned Brio kettle missing accessories is refunded at 47% of the price.

This condition applies to an eligible change of mind return where supplied accessories have not been included. If an accessory was missing when your order arrived, tell us when requesting the return. We will assess that as an issue with the order rather than assume that you have failed to return it.

Please return the Brio kettle clean and free from loose debris, surface grease and water residue. Follow the care instructions supplied with it. Do not use abrasive pads, harsh cleaning chemicals or unsuitable descaling products to prepare it for return, as these may damage the finish or internal components.

A returned Brio kettle that needs cleaning is charged £60.00.

We will explain any cleaning charge that applies to your return and identify the condition that required cleaning. Do not attempt to clean damage that may involve an electrical fault or make the Brio kettle unsafe to handle. Contact us instead and describe what has happened so we can advise you safely.

A returned Brio kettle is inspected within 3 days of arrival.

During inspection, we check the Brio kettle, its accessories and the condition in which the parcel arrived. We look for damage, signs of use, missing parts and cleaning needs. We also compare our findings with the reason you gave for returning it, including any fault or damage you reported.

Photographs of the Brio kettle and the packed parcel can help if there is a disagreement about condition or transit damage. Keep your proof of posting and any correspondence about the return. These can support our enquiries, although they do not replace any evidence we are legally required to consider.

If our assessment affects your refund, we will explain the reason and how to query it. Tell us if you believe we have misunderstood the condition or overlooked information you provided. Where your statutory rights require a different outcome, those rights take priority over the packaging, accessory and cleaning conditions set out here.

If you bought your Tessa dishwasher directly from Halvard Home, contact our customer care team to arrange a return. Tell us whether you have changed your mind, received the wrong appliance or found a problem. This helps us explain the return arrangements that apply to you.

Please provide your order reference, the name used for the purchase and the address where the appliance is held. Describe its condition and let us know whether it has been unpacked, installed or used. We may ask for photographs to help assess damage or identify a fault.

If you bought your Tessa dishwasher from another retailer, contact that retailer about its returns process. Your rights against the retailer are not affected by this policy. We can still help with questions about the appliance, but we cannot approve a refund for a purchase made elsewhere.

For a change-of-mind return under our voluntary returns service, the condition of the appliance affects the refund. A restocking charge of 24% of the price applies to an opened Tessa dishwasher. We will explain any proposed deduction before you agree to use that service.

This charge does not override your legal rights. If you are exercising a statutory cancellation right, any deduction must be permitted by law and reflect handling beyond what is needed to establish the appliance’s nature, characteristics and functioning. Different rules apply where the appliance is faulty or not as described.

Collection of a returned Tessa dishwasher costs £27.00. This is the collection charge for a change-of-mind return where you are responsible for return costs. We will not charge you for a collection that we are legally required to provide at our expense.

Please do not send the appliance to us without arranging the return. Our customer care team will confirm the collection address and explain how to prepare it. Tell us about stairs, restricted access, parking difficulties or anything else that could prevent the collection team from reaching the appliance safely.

A returns label for the Tessa dishwasher is emailed within 2 hours of the request. Check that the email address you provide is correct, and look in your junk folder if the message is missing. Contact customer care if you cannot find or print the label.

Follow the instructions supplied with the label. Attach it securely to the packaging so that it can be read without opening the parcel. Remove or cover delivery labels that could cause confusion, while leaving the appliance’s identification and safety markings intact.

Before collection, remove dishes, detergent and personal belongings from the appliance. Drain it and prepare it for transport in line with the care instructions. Do not attempt electrical or plumbing work unless you are competent to do so; arrange professional help if you are unsure.

The appliance must be safely disconnected and accessible for collection. Let us know if a fault makes draining, disconnecting or moving it unsafe. Do not use an appliance that appears unsafe, and do not put yourself at risk to meet a collection requirement.

Use the original packaging if you still have it. If you do not, tell customer care so that we can discuss suitable protection for transport. Missing original packaging does not remove your statutory rights, but secure packing helps prevent avoidable damage during the return.

Include the accessories and loose parts supplied with the appliance, unless we ask you to keep them. Tell us about anything missing or damaged rather than adding replacement items yourself. We will explain whether this affects a voluntary return or any refund deduction permitted by law.

An exchange for a Tessa dishwasher in a different colour must be requested within 86 days. For our voluntary exchange service, this period runs from delivery. Colour exchanges depend on availability and the appliance’s condition, and do not restrict any separate legal right you may have.

We will confirm whether the requested colour is available and explain the exchange arrangements before you agree to proceed. If it is unavailable, customer care will discuss the options open to you. We will not substitute a different colour without your agreement.

When the returned appliance reaches us, we will check its condition against the details you provided. If our assessment differs, we will explain the reason and any proposed effect on your refund. You can provide photographs or other relevant information if you disagree.

Approved refunds are made to the original payment method unless we agree otherwise. We will send confirmation explaining the refund and any lawful deductions. If you have questions about the assessment, collection or payment, contact customer care so that we can review the return with you.

Pack your Tessa dishwasher so that it can be moved safely and arrives in the condition you intend to return it. Packaging should protect the appliance, keep loose parts secure and prevent water from escaping. Please take care when preparing it, whether it has been used or remains unused.

Keep the original packaging if you still have it. The shaped supports, protective wrapping and outer carton are designed to protect vulnerable areas during transport. Check that these materials remain strong enough to use, rather than relying on packaging that is torn, crushed or softened by moisture.

You do not need the original packaging to request a return. If it is unavailable or unsuitable, use sturdy replacement packaging that provides protection around the appliance. Tell Halvard Home if you cannot package the dishwasher safely, so we can discuss suitable arrangements before collection or dispatch.

Disconnect the dishwasher from its power and water supplies in accordance with its instructions. Drain any remaining water from the appliance and its hoses. If you are unsure how to disconnect it safely, seek help from a suitably qualified person rather than attempting work that could cause injury or damage.

Empty the dishwasher completely. Remove dishes, food scraps and anything else that does not belong with the appliance. Check the interior, filter area and accessible recesses for personal belongings. Do not leave detergent, rinse aid containers or cleaning products loose inside the packaging.

A Tessa dishwasher must come back with everything that was in the box. A return missing accessories is refunded at 58% of the price.

Check the supplied parts against the information that came with your appliance. Include its baskets, fittings, hoses, documents and other supplied accessories where applicable. If you are unsure whether something should be included, ask us before sending the return. Tell us about missing items rather than substituting unrelated parts.

Secure removable items so they cannot slide around or strike the interior during handling. Wrap accessories separately where needed, while keeping them within the return packaging. Do not force parts into place or use the door to hold loose items under pressure, as this could damage the appliance.

Make sure the door is closed and protected against opening in transit. Cushion exposed edges, controls and connections. Keep the power lead and hoses secure without bending, trapping or stretching them. Avoid applying adhesive tape directly to finished surfaces where it could leave marks or lift the finish.

A returned Tessa dishwasher that needs cleaning is charged £48.00.

To avoid this charge, return the appliance clean, with food residue, grease and standing water removed. Wipe accessible surfaces and clean removable parts in accordance with the care instructions. Allow wet parts to dry before packing. Do not use harsh chemicals or abrasive materials that could damage the finish.

Cleaning should not involve dismantling parts that the care instructions do not identify as removable. If a fault prevents you from draining or cleaning the dishwasher safely, tell us when arranging the return. Explain the problem clearly so that we can advise you without asking you to risk injury or further damage.

Please describe the condition of the appliance honestly when requesting your return. Tell us about scratches, dents, broken fittings, leaks or signs of damage. Photographs of the dishwasher and its packaging can help us understand its condition and deal with questions about damage that may have occurred in transport.

If your dishwasher arrived damaged, preserve the packaging where it is safe to do so and contact us for guidance. Do not attempt repairs to make the appliance suitable for return. You should not put yourself at risk by handling sharp edges, exposed electrical parts or unstable packaging.

A returned Tessa dishwasher is inspected within 47 days of arrival.

During inspection, we check the appliance, its cleanliness and the contents of the return against the information you have provided. We will explain any condition issue that affects the refund and identify any missing accessories or cleaning charge. Keep your photographs and return correspondence available in case clarification is needed.

These packaging and condition requirements do not remove your statutory rights. If you are returning a faulty dishwasher, an appliance that was not as described, or an item damaged on delivery, we will consider the circumstances and apply your legal rights. Contact us if you believe a proposed charge or refund adjustment is incorrect.

If you want to return your Orrin heat pump, contact Halvard Home customer support through our website. Tell us why you would like to return it and whether it has been unpacked, installed or used. Please wait for return instructions before arranging transport.

Have your order confirmation and delivery details available when you contact us. If someone else placed the order, we may need their permission to discuss it or arrange a refund. We will explain what information is needed.

If your appliance arrived damaged, appears faulty or does not match its description, explain the problem when you contact us. Photographs can help us understand visible damage, but do not dismantle the appliance or attempt repairs to gather evidence.

Returns because you have changed your mind are handled differently from returns involving a fault, damage or an incorrect description. We will explain which process applies to your request. Nothing in this policy limits your statutory rights.

For an accepted change of mind return, the following condition applies. A restocking charge of 13% of the price applies once the packaging is opened. This charge does not apply where applying it would conflict with your statutory rights.

Collection of a returned Orrin heat pump costs £93.00. This is the collection charge for an accepted change of mind return. Where we are legally responsible for return costs, we will arrange an appropriate return method without charging you.

A returns label for the Orrin heat pump is emailed within 22 hours of the request. Check that the email address you provide is correct and look in your junk folder if the message has not arrived.

The label identifies your return; it does not confirm a collection booking. Follow the instructions included with it and contact customer support if you cannot print it. Do not send the appliance to an address found elsewhere.

Keep the appliance safe while your return is being arranged. If you are returning it because you have changed your mind, stop using it and avoid handling that could damage its finish, fittings or packaging.

If the appliance is installed, tell us before collection is booked. It must be safely disconnected by a suitably qualified professional where required. Do not attempt electrical or other specialist work yourself, and do not move an appliance that remains connected.

We will discuss any preparation needed for your particular installation. Do not assume that the collection team can disconnect the appliance, remove fixed fittings or make alterations to your home. Any necessary work must be agreed separately.

Use the original packaging if it is available and suitable for transport. Include the accessories and documents supplied with the appliance unless we tell you otherwise. Remove personal items and check that nothing unrelated has been packed with it.

If the packaging is missing or damaged, contact us for advice before packing the appliance. Explain its condition and where it is located so we can discuss safe handling. Do not improvise packaging that leaves sharp edges or loose parts exposed.

Tell us about stairs, narrow access, parking restrictions or other obstacles when arranging collection. We need accurate access information to make suitable arrangements. If circumstances change, let customer support know rather than relying on instructions left for the collection team.

An adult who can authorise the handover should be present for collection. Keep the agreed access route clear and retain any collection receipt. If collection cannot proceed safely, contact us so we can discuss what needs to happen next.

When the return reaches us, we will check the appliance against your request and assess its condition. If anything affects the proposed refund, we will explain the reason and give you an opportunity to respond.

Approved refunds are made to the original payment method unless we agree otherwise. We will confirm when the refund has been issued. Your payment provider controls when it appears in your account; contact us if you need help tracing it.

An exchange for a Orrin heat pump in a different colour must be requested within 87 days. Contact customer support to check availability and discuss the return arrangements before sending your existing appliance back.

Requesting an exchange does not reserve the colour you want. We will explain availability, any applicable charges and the arrangements for returning your appliance before you decide whether to proceed. Any statutory remedy you are entitled to remains available.

If you disagree with a return decision, ask customer support to review it. Include the relevant correspondence and explain what you believe has been overlooked. We will consider the information you provide and explain our response in plain language.

Keep the original packaging of the Orrin heat pump for 55 days in case it needs to be returned. Store the carton, protective inserts and wrapping somewhere dry and secure. Keeping these materials makes it easier to protect the appliance during transport and helps prevent damage that could affect your return.

Open the packaging carefully and avoid tearing through protective materials where possible. Take care with staples, sharp edges and loose wrapping. Keep packaging away from children and pets, and do not leave it where it could block access, ventilation or a safe route through your home.

You may unpack the Orrin heat pump to check its appearance and assess whether it is suitable for your needs. Handle it carefully and follow the supplied safety instructions. Avoid removing protective coverings unnecessarily, and do not make changes to the casing, fittings or other parts just to inspect it.

If you decide to return the appliance, contact Halvard Home so we can explain the appropriate return arrangements. Tell us whether it has been unpacked, installed, connected or used. This helps us give suitable handling advice and identify whether professional disconnection or other precautions are needed for a safe return.

Do not attempt to disconnect an installed Orrin heat pump unless you are qualified to carry out the work safely. Follow the installation guidance and use a suitably qualified professional where required. Do not open sealed components, interfere with refrigerant connections or try to drain the appliance without appropriate advice.

Use the original packaging where it remains suitable for transport. Place protective inserts around the appliance as intended, making sure that loose materials cannot enter openings or catch on exposed parts. The appliance should sit securely inside its packaging without being forced into position or pressed against unprotected surfaces.

If the original packaging is missing or damaged, tell us when arranging your return. We can advise on suitable replacement packaging and any handling requirements. Missing original packaging does not by itself remove your statutory rights, but inadequate protection may result in damage that affects how a change of mind return is assessed.

Replacement packaging must be strong enough for the appliance and suitable for the agreed transport method. Soft wrapping alone may not provide adequate protection. Do not rely on damaged cartons, loose padding or exposed straps that could move, break or mark the casing during handling.

Include the accessories supplied with the Orrin heat pump, together with any removable parts, instructions and other supplied materials. Secure these so they cannot move freely or scratch the appliance. Do not include unrelated belongings, tools or items belonging to an installer, as these may be difficult to identify and recover.

A returned Orrin heat pump missing accessories is refunded at 83% of the price. Check the contents carefully and tell us about anything you cannot return. This deduction applies to eligible change of mind returns and does not override any statutory remedy you have for faulty or misdescribed goods.

A return that needs cleaning is charged £17.00. Remove ordinary surface dirt using the cleaning method described in the care instructions. Do not use abrasive materials, harsh chemicals or excessive moisture. These can damage finishes or components and may make the appliance unsafe to handle or transport.

Tell us if the appliance has been exposed to smoke, grease, pests, mould or other contamination. Do not conceal contamination beneath wrapping or attempt cleaning that could put you at risk. We may need to agree specialist handling arrangements rather than use the usual return process.

A returned Orrin heat pump is inspected within 29 days of arrival. We check its condition, the supplied contents and any signs of damage or contamination. We also consider the reason for return and any information you have given us about its delivery, installation, handling or use.

Photographs of the appliance and its packed condition can help if there is a question about damage during transport. Keep any relevant delivery records and tell us about marks, dents or damaged packaging you noticed on receipt. You do not need to hide existing damage or attempt repairs to make a return.

If our assessment affects your refund, we will explain the reason and any applicable deduction. You can ask us to review the assessment and provide information you think we have missed. These packaging and condition requirements do not restrict your statutory rights where the Orrin heat pump is faulty, misdescribed or otherwise does not meet the requirements of consumer law.

If you want to return your Lumen smart thermostat, please contact Halvard Home customer support before sending it back. Tell us whether you would like a refund or an exchange, and explain the reason for the return. We will confirm the return arrangements and explain which charges, if any, apply to your request.

Please have your proof of purchase available when you contact us. This could be your order confirmation, receipt or other evidence showing that you bought the appliance from Halvard Home. If you bought it from a different retailer, contact that retailer about its returns process. We can still help with questions about the appliance itself.

An unopened Lumen smart thermostat is refunded in full, but opening the box changes that. A restocking charge of 18% of the price applies once the packaging is opened. These are our voluntary change-of-mind terms, not a restriction on your legal rights. The restocking charge does not apply where consumer law entitles you to return the appliance without that charge.

If you are returning the appliance because it is faulty, damaged, not as described or otherwise does not meet your legal rights, please tell us when you contact us. We will assess the problem and explain the remedies available. You do not need to describe a fault in technical terms; a clear account of what happened is enough.

Do not continue using an appliance that appears unsafe. If there is visible damage, an unusual smell or a problem with the wiring, avoid handling exposed electrical parts and seek help from a suitably qualified installer. Customer support can help arrange the return, but cannot replace an installer’s assessment of whether disconnection is safe.

Before packing the appliance, remove it from your connected account and clear your personal settings if you can safely do so. Follow the reset instructions supplied with the appliance or available through our support service. If a fault prevents you from resetting it, let us know. This will not prevent us from considering a return under your legal rights.

Arrange safe disconnection before the collection or return. Do not pull the appliance from its mounting or attempt work on electrical wiring unless you are competent to carry it out safely. Ask customer support about any concerns before arranging removal. We will explain whether removal costs can be covered as part of an agreed remedy.

Pack the appliance securely, with its supplied accessories and any removable parts needed for normal operation. Use the original packaging if you still have it, or suitable protective packaging if you do not. Missing packaging does not remove your legal rights. Tell us about missing accessories so that we can explain any effect on a voluntary return.

Collection of a returned Lumen smart thermostat costs £19.00. This charge applies to our standard collection service for a change-of-mind return. Where we are responsible for return costs under consumer law, we will arrange an appropriate return method without charging you. We will explain how any applicable collection charge is paid before you agree to collection.

Make sure the parcel is ready and accessible as agreed with customer support. If access is difficult or your collection arrangements change, let us know so that we can discuss an alternative. Keep any collection receipt or proof of posting until the return is resolved. Do not send the appliance to an address that we have not confirmed.

An exchange for a Lumen smart thermostat in a different colour must be requested within 69 days. For this voluntary exchange offer, the period runs from delivery. Exchanges depend on the requested colour being available and the returned appliance meeting the applicable change-of-mind conditions. We will explain any charges before you decide whether to proceed.

If the inspection identifies damage, missing items or a condition issue that may affect your refund, we will explain what we found. Any proposed deduction will be explained and must be permitted by law. We will not treat a reported manufacturing fault as damage caused by you.

These packaging and condition requirements do not replace your legal rights. If the hob arrived damaged, developed a fault or was not as described, tell us so that we can assess your return appropriately. Contact Halvard Home if you need help preparing it safely.

Please contact Halvard Home before returning your Fenwick cooker hood so we can explain the return arrangements that apply to your purchase. Tell us why you wish to return it and provide your order reference, contact details and collection address if you would like us to arrange collection.

If the appliance is faulty, damaged or different from what you ordered, please explain the problem when you contact us. Photographs can help us understand visible damage, but please do not put yourself at risk to take them. We will explain the appropriate return arrangements and any information we need.

If you have changed your mind, let us know whether the appliance has been unpacked, fitted or used. This helps us explain how its condition may affect your return. Please do not continue using an appliance you intend to send back.

Halvard Home can collect a Fenwick cooker hood that is being returned. Collection of a return costs £57.00.

When you request collection, tell us about any access restrictions that could affect the collection team. These might include stairs, narrow entrances, parking restrictions or a shared entrance. We will discuss the arrangements with you before confirming collection. Please do not leave the appliance outside or in an unattended communal area.

The collection charge does not apply where we are responsible for the return costs because the appliance is faulty, damaged or not as described. We will explain whether a charge applies to your return before you agree to collection. Nothing in this policy limits your statutory rights.

A Fenwick cooker hood sent back by courier needs a printed returns label. A returns label is emailed within 28 hours of the request.

Check that the email address you give us is correct and look in your junk folder if the label has not arrived. If you cannot find the email or cannot print the label, contact us for help before handing the package to a courier.

Attach the label securely to the outside of the package, where it can be read clearly. Remove or cover old delivery labels so the package is not sent to the wrong address. Follow the return instructions supplied with the label rather than using an address from an earlier delivery.

Before packing the appliance, make sure it is disconnected safely. If it is wired into your electrical supply, arrange for a qualified electrician to disconnect it. Do not cut cables or attempt work you are not qualified to carry out. Collection does not include removal from its installed position.

Allow the appliance to cool and make sure it is clean and dry before handling it. Take care around exposed edges and loose fittings. If the appliance is damaged in a way that makes it unsafe to move or pack, contact us for advice rather than trying to prepare it yourself.

Use the original packaging if you still have it and it is suitable for transport. Otherwise, use strong packaging that protects the appliance and prevents movement inside the package. Protect exposed surfaces and secure loose parts separately so they cannot scratch or damage the appliance during handling.

An exchange for a Fenwick cooker hood in a different colour must be requested within 96 days.

Tell us which colour you would prefer when making your request. An exchange depends on availability, and we will confirm what we can offer before you send the appliance back. Please do not assume that requesting an exchange reserves stock or confirms dispatch.

Include the accessories, fittings and documents supplied with the appliance unless we have asked you to retain them. Let us know if anything is missing. Do not include unrelated belongings or original purchase documents that you need to keep; retain your own record of the return.

Keep evidence that the appliance has been collected or accepted by the courier, along with any tracking details. If a collection cannot go ahead, or the courier refuses the package, contact us so we can help resolve the problem. Please do not make alternative arrangements without checking with us.

When the return arrives, we will check the appliance against the information you provided and contact you about the outcome. If its condition raises a question about your refund or exchange, we will explain the issue and give you an opportunity to respond before deciding how to proceed.

Keep the original packaging of the Fenwick cooker hood for 8 days in case it needs to be returned. Store the carton, protective inserts and wrapping somewhere dry and clean. Keeping these materials together helps you protect the appliance during transport and makes it easier to prepare a return without searching for suitable packing materials.

The packaging should support the appliance securely and prevent it from moving around inside the carton. Retain shaped inserts where possible, as these help protect exposed edges and surfaces. Keep packaging away from heat, damp and anything that could weaken it or transfer stains or smells to the appliance.

If the original packaging has been lost or damaged, contact Halvard Home for packing advice before sending the appliance back. Missing original packaging does not automatically prevent a return. However, unsuitable packaging can leave the appliance exposed to damage, so please do not send it in a weak carton or loose wrapping.

Use a sturdy outer carton and suitable cushioning if replacement packaging is needed. Protect corners, projecting parts and finished surfaces without placing adhesive tape directly on the appliance. Packing materials should be clean and should not scratch, stain or stick to the surface when removed.

Before packing, make sure the Fenwick cooker hood is disconnected safely. If it has been installed or connected to fixed wiring, arrange for a suitably qualified person to remove it. Do not attempt electrical work yourself unless you are qualified to do so. Tell us if safe removal presents a problem.

Handle the appliance carefully during removal and packing. Avoid dragging it across worktops or floors, and do not lift it by parts that may bend or come loose. If any part appears unstable, sharp or damaged, stop handling it and contact us for advice on preparing the return safely.

Please return the appliance in a clean, dry condition where it is safe and reasonable to do so. Remove loose dirt and surface grease gently, following the care instructions supplied with it. Do not use abrasive cleaners or try to disguise marks, faults or signs of use.

You may inspect the appliance to understand its appearance and features. If you are returning it because you have changed your mind, handling beyond what is reasonably needed for that inspection may affect your refund, where the law allows. Installation, use, scratches or alterations may be relevant to that assessment.

If the appliance arrived damaged or appears faulty, do not carry out repairs or make alterations before contacting us. Explain what you have noticed and provide photographs if you can do so safely. We may ask for images of the packaging as well as the affected area to help assess the problem.

Include the accessories, fittings, removable parts and documents supplied with the appliance. Check storage areas and the place where the appliance was unpacked before sealing the carton. Pack loose items securely so that they cannot move against the appliance, scratch its finish or become lost when the carton is opened.

A returned Fenwick cooker hood missing accessories is refunded at 86% of the price. Tell us before dispatch if you know that an accessory is missing, including whether it was absent when the appliance arrived. This missing-accessory rule does not override your statutory rights where goods are faulty, damaged or not as described.

Place the return information provided by Halvard Home inside the carton, keeping it separate from surfaces that could be marked. Remove or cover old delivery labels on the outside, then attach the return label clearly. Do not include unrelated belongings or personal documents that are not needed to identify your return.

A returned Fenwick cooker hood is inspected within 38 days of arrival. The inspection checks the condition of the appliance, the contents of the package and any damage reported with the return. We consider the information you provide alongside what is found when the package is opened.

If the inspection raises a concern about damage, handling or missing contents, we will explain the issue and how it affects the proposed refund. You can provide relevant photographs or other evidence if you disagree with the findings. Keep your proof of dispatch and any packing photographs available to support your query.

These packaging and condition requirements help protect the appliance and support a fair assessment of its return. They do not remove or limit your statutory rights. If following these instructions would be unsafe, or the appliance cannot be packed as described because of its condition, contact Halvard Home for guidance before dispatch.

To return your Mira robot vacuum, contact Halvard Home customer care and explain why you would like to return it. Please provide your name, contact details and proof of purchase. A receipt or order confirmation helps us find your purchase and explain the arrangements that apply.

Please wait for return instructions before sending the appliance to us. We will confirm where it needs to go and whether a collection or a parcel return is appropriate. Sending it to an address shown elsewhere on our website could make it harder for us to identify and process your return.

If you have changed your mind, tell us whether the packaging has been opened and whether the appliance has been used. Describe its condition honestly, including any marks, damage or missing accessories. We will explain whether your return can be accepted and any deductions that may apply before you arrange to send it.

A restocking charge of 5% of the price applies to an opened Mira robot vacuum. This charge applies to accepted change-of-mind returns under our voluntary returns arrangements, where permitted by law. It does not apply where you are exercising a statutory cancellation right or returning an appliance because it is faulty, not as described or otherwise fails to meet your legal rights.

If the appliance appears faulty, describe the problem when you contact us. Photographs may help explain visible damage, but please do not attempt to dismantle the appliance or carry out a repair to support your request. We may ask questions about the fault so that we can arrange a suitable return method.

Stop using the appliance if you believe it may be unsafe. Tell customer care about any unusual heat, smoke, leaking or damage to the battery. Do not send an appliance with suspected battery damage through the post or an ordinary parcel service without our instructions. We will explain how to handle the return safely.

Before packing the appliance, switch it off and disconnect it from its charging equipment. Empty the dust container and remove loose dirt where it is safe to do so. Do not wash electrical parts or pack the appliance while it is damp. Follow the care instructions supplied with it.

Remove your personal settings and disconnect the appliance from your account where possible. If a fault prevents this, let us know rather than continuing to operate it. Check the packaging for personal belongings, and do not include passwords or other sensitive account information with your return.

Pack the appliance securely with the accessories supplied with it, unless customer care has asked you to leave anything out. Original packaging is helpful, but suitable protective packaging is acceptable. Tell us if you cannot pack the appliance safely so that we can discuss the available arrangements.

A returns label for the Mira robot vacuum is emailed within 25 hours of the request. Please check that the email address you give us is correct and look in your junk folder if the message has not arrived. Contact customer care if you cannot find the label or cannot print it.

Use the label and return method we provide. Remove or cover old delivery labels on reused packaging so that the parcel can be routed correctly. Keep your proof of posting or collection until we confirm that your return has been received and resolved.

Collection of a returned Mira robot vacuum costs £49.00. This charge applies to an optional collection for an accepted change-of-mind return where permitted by law. We will explain how payment is taken before confirming the booking. You will not be asked to pay this charge where Halvard Home is legally responsible for the return costs.

An exchange for a Mira robot vacuum in a different colour must be requested within 61 days. Contact customer care to discuss availability and the condition requirements for an exchange. This voluntary exchange arrangement does not restrict your statutory rights if there is a problem with the appliance.

We will inspect the returned appliance and contact you about the outcome. If we believe a deduction is justified, we will explain the reason and how it has been calculated. Any refund due will normally be made to the original payment method, unless we agree a suitable alternative with you.

Nothing in these return arrangements takes away your rights under consumer law. If your request involves a faulty appliance, a delivery problem or a statutory cancellation, tell us so that we can apply the appropriate process rather than treating it as a voluntary change-of-mind return.

Keep the original packaging of the Mira robot vacuum for 53 days in case it needs to be returned. Store the box, protective inserts and wrapping somewhere dry and safe. Keeping these materials makes it easier to protect the appliance in transit, but you do not need to keep disposable delivery wrapping that has no protective purpose.

If you no longer have the original packaging, use a strong box with suitable cushioning. The appliance should sit securely inside without pressing against the sides or moving around when the box is handled. Avoid loose packing materials that could enter openings or become caught in moving parts. Contact Halvard Home if you are unsure whether your packaging is suitable.

Switch off the Mira robot vacuum before preparing it for return. Disconnect the charging equipment from the power supply and remove the appliance from its charging position. Follow the safety instructions supplied with the appliance when handling removable parts. Do not take apart the casing or attempt repairs as part of preparing your return.

Remove collected dust, hair and household debris from the dust container and accessible cleaning parts. Empty any removable container that holds liquid, where applicable, and make sure the appliance and its accessories are dry before packing. Do not rinse electrical components or use cleaning products that are not recommended in the care instructions. You do not need to dismantle the appliance to clean it.

A returned Mira robot vacuum that needs cleaning is charged £15.00. This charge applies where cleaning is needed to remove dirt or debris left in the returned appliance, subject to your statutory rights. We will explain the reason for any cleaning charge and how it affects your refund. Do not attempt cleaning that would be unsafe because of a fault or damage.

Include the accessories supplied with your Mira robot vacuum, including its charging equipment and any removable parts that belong with it. Check cupboards, storage spaces and the area where the appliance was used for anything that may have been set aside. Do not include unrelated household items or accessories bought separately unless Halvard Home has asked you to return them.

A returned Mira robot vacuum missing accessories is refunded at 64% of the price. Where this rule applies, the price means the price you paid for the appliance, rather than its advertised price before a discount. We will identify the missing accessories when explaining the refund. This rule does not override any statutory entitlement to a different remedy.

Pack accessories so that they cannot scratch the appliance or damage its controls. Keep cables neatly gathered without pulling them tight, and cushion loose parts separately. Protect exposed surfaces with clean, soft packing material. Close the box securely and remove or cover old delivery labels so that they cannot be confused with the return label provided for your parcel.

If the Mira robot vacuum is damaged, leaking, unusually hot or showing signs of battery damage, do not pack or send it without advice from Halvard Home. Tell us what you have noticed and follow the return instructions we provide. Damaged electrical appliances may need special handling, and ordinary parcel services may not be suitable for carrying them.

A returned Mira robot vacuum is inspected within 58 days of arrival. The inspection checks the condition of the appliance, whether the expected accessories are included and whether cleaning is needed. We also review any fault or damage you have reported. The inspection period does not replace any refund deadline or other obligation that applies under consumer law.

Please describe known faults, damage or missing items when arranging your return. Clear photographs can help explain the condition, although they do not replace an inspection. Be open about normal use and any accidental damage. We assess the returned appliance against the reason for the return and the rights that apply, rather than assuming that signs of use automatically prevent a refund.

Remove personal information from the appliance using the instructions supplied with it, where this is possible and safe. If a fault prevents you from doing this, let Halvard Home know. Keep your proof of purchase and return dispatch receipt. If you disagree with a condition assessment or a deduction, contact us for an explanation and a review of the evidence.

Extended Care adds 59 days to the standard returns window. This benefit lets you request a return under the plan if you change your mind about an eligible purchase. It does not affect your legal rights if something is faulty, damaged or not as described.

To use this benefit, your Extended Care membership must have been active when you placed the order. The purchase must be linked to your membership and made directly from Halvard Home. Purchases from another retailer should be returned through that retailer’s returns process.

The extended returns window follows the standard returns window for your purchase. Please contact us within the applicable window to tell us you want to return your item. Simply sending an item back without contacting us may make it harder to identify your return.

You can start a return through your Halvard Home account or by contacting our customer care team. Have your order confirmation and membership details available so we can check eligibility. If you cannot find them, we can help you locate your purchase.

Tell us which item you would like to return and whether it has been unpacked, installed or used. Please also tell us about any damage or missing packaging. This helps us explain the return arrangements and avoid surprises when your item reaches us.

For a change of mind return under Extended Care, the item must be unused, complete and in a condition suitable for resale. You may unpack it to inspect it, but using it goes beyond the inspection allowed under this benefit.

Please return the accessories, instructions and other materials supplied with the item. Keep the original packaging where possible, as it is designed to protect the contents during transport. If you no longer have it, contact us before arranging the return.

Missing original packaging does not automatically prevent a return. We will explain whether suitable replacement packaging is needed and whether we can help arrange it. Do not send an item in packaging that leaves it exposed or unable to travel safely.

Extended Care members get 62% off collection charges. The discount applies to eligible collections arranged by Halvard Home for returns under the plan. We will confirm the collection charge with the discount applied before you agree to the booking.

The collection discount does not apply to transport you arrange yourself. If you would prefer to use your own carrier, speak to us about the return address and packing requirements. You are responsible for any carrier charge you agree to.

Before collection, make sure the item is safely disconnected and ready to move. Where disconnection needs specialist knowledge, use a suitably qualified professional. Our collection team cannot carry out work that requires a qualified installer or make unsafe connections safe.

Let us know about stairs, restricted access, parking difficulties or anything else that could affect collection. We will discuss suitable arrangements with you. If the collection cannot go ahead because the item or access is not ready, a further charge may apply.

We will explain any proposed collection charge before making a new booking. If you need to change your arrangements, contact customer care so we can help. Please do not leave the item outside or unattended unless we have expressly agreed a safe collection arrangement.

Remove personal belongings and clear any personal information stored on the item before handing it over. Sign out of linked services where relevant. If you need help finding the appropriate instructions, our customer care team can direct you to the available guidance.

When the returned item reaches us, we will inspect it against the conditions of the plan. If there is a problem, we will contact you to explain what we have found and discuss what happens next before making a decision.

If your return is accepted, we will arrange the refund to the original payment method wherever possible. We will confirm how any collection charge and delivery charge are treated before you commit to the return. Your payment provider controls when the refund appears in your account.

If your item is faulty, damaged or not as described, tell us when you contact us. We will handle your request under the relevant faulty goods process rather than treating it as a change of mind return. The plan’s condition requirements do not limit your statutory rights.

If we cannot agree on whether your return qualifies, you can ask customer care to review the decision. We will explain the reasons for our response and how to raise a complaint if you remain unhappy.

cell.item: POL-RET/Extended Care Plus/Returns under the plan

result.text:
Extended Care Plus adds 14 days to the standard returns window. The extension applies to eligible purchases covered by your plan and gives you more flexibility if you change your mind. Your order details show whether your purchase is covered.

To use the extended returns window, your plan must have been active when you placed the order. Adding the plan after a purchase does not change the returns terms for that purchase. Please contact us if your order details do not match the cover you expected.

The extension follows directly after the standard returns window. You must tell us that you want to return your purchase before the extended window closes. Starting a return does not mean that collection has been arranged; we will confirm the arrangements with you.

You can request a return through your Halvard Home account or by contacting customer support. Have your order confirmation available and explain what you would like to return. We may ask for information that helps us find your purchase and check your plan membership.

Please tell us whether you have changed your mind or whether there is a fault, damage or another problem. This helps us apply the correct returns process. You do not have to accept a change-of-mind return where your legal rights provide a different remedy.

For a change-of-mind return, please keep your purchase in a condition that allows us to inspect it and offer it for sale again. You may examine it as you would in a shop, but please avoid using it beyond what is needed to assess it.

Return the accessories, instructions and other contents supplied with your purchase. Please use the original packaging if you still have it. If the packaging is missing or damaged, contact us before sending anything back so we can explain how to prepare the return safely.

Do not attempt to disconnect anything if doing so could be unsafe. Tell us about any installation or access issues when requesting your return. We will explain what needs to be done before collection and whether you need help from a suitably qualified person.

Extended Care Plus members get 84% off collection charges. This discount applies to our usual collection service for eligible change-of-mind returns under the plan. We will explain the collection charge before you agree to the booking, so you can decide whether to proceed.

The membership discount does not make you responsible for a collection charge where we are legally required to cover the return. If your purchase is faulty, damaged or not as described, contact us so we can explain the available remedies and arrange an appropriate return.

Collection depends on access to your address and the condition of the return. Please tell us about stairs, restricted parking or anything else that could affect safe collection. We will let you know if the usual service is unsuitable and discuss the available options.

Please have your return ready as agreed and make sure it is safe for our collection team to handle. If the arrangements no longer work for you, contact us promptly. We will explain any applicable cancellation charge before confirming a replacement booking.

Remove personal belongings and any personal information stored on or linked to your purchase before handing it over. If you need guidance, ask customer support. Keep your collection confirmation or proof of posting until we confirm that your return has been received and resolved.

When the return reaches us, we will check its condition and confirm the refund due. Where the law allows, we may reduce a change-of-mind refund to reflect loss in value caused by handling beyond what was necessary to inspect the purchase.

We will explain any proposed reduction and the reason for it. Refunds are normally sent to the payment method used for the purchase. If that is not possible, we will contact you to agree a suitable alternative rather than asking you to share payment details through an insecure channel.

Returning a purchase does not automatically cancel your Extended Care Plus membership. If you also want to cancel the plan, contact us or use the cancellation option in your account. The plan cancellation terms explain how that request is handled.

These plan benefits are additional to your statutory rights and do not replace or restrict them. If you are unsure which returns terms apply, contact customer support. We will explain your options clearly and help you choose the appropriate route for your circumstances.

Collections in Scotland North are made within 49 working days of a return being booked. To arrange a collection, contact Halvard Home customer care through the contact details shown on our website or in your order confirmation. Please explain why you are returning your purchase so we can help you follow the appropriate return process.

We will ask for information that helps us find your order and confirm where the collection will take place. Please have your order confirmation available if you can. If you cannot find it, let us know so we can discuss another way to identify your purchase and check your return request.

Please tell us about access to the collection address when you book. This includes stairs, narrow entrances, restricted parking, shared access and any local conditions that could affect the driver’s visit. Accurate information helps us arrange a suitable collection and reduces the risk of the driver being unable to collect your return safely.

If you need support with the collection process because of a disability, health condition or communication need, please tell customer care. We will discuss reasonable adjustments with you and explain what support can be arranged. You do not need to share medical details that are unrelated to the help you require.

We will confirm your collection booking using the contact details you provide. Please check that the collection address and your contact information are correct. Tell us about any mistakes or changes as soon as you become aware of them, especially if they could prevent the driver from reaching you or finding the address.

Collection drivers in Scotland North give an arrival window of 156 minutes. Please make sure you can be contacted and that someone authorised to hand over the return is available at the address. If you cannot be available for the confirmed visit, contact customer care to discuss changing the booking.

Before collection, remove your personal belongings and prepare the return using the instructions we provide. Please do not attempt anything that you cannot do safely. If preparation requires help or you are unsure what is needed, contact us rather than risking injury or damage. We will explain how to proceed.

Keep any packaging you still have and tell us if it is missing or damaged. We will explain whether packaging is needed for the collection and discuss suitable arrangements with you. Missing original packaging does not, by itself, remove your statutory rights where your purchase is faulty or not as described.

Please keep the route to the return clear and make sure pets are safely away from the collection area. Do not leave the return outside or in an unsecured place unless we have expressly agreed this with you. The driver must be able to collect it without putting people or property at risk.

The driver may decline to proceed if the collection cannot be carried out safely or if the return is not ready under the agreed arrangements. If this happens, contact customer care so we can review the circumstances, explain what needs to change and help arrange a suitable way forward.

Weather, transport disruption and access problems can affect collections in this region. If we become aware that your confirmed visit cannot go ahead, we will contact you using the details on your booking. We will explain the next steps and discuss a replacement booking rather than leaving you to make fresh arrangements without support.

If a collection charge applies to your return, we will explain it before you agree to the booking. We will also tell you whether it is payable separately or will be deducted from your refund. Charges depend on the reason for the return and must not restrict your statutory rights.

After collection, we will check the return against your request and contact you if we need clarification. Please retain any collection confirmation you receive until your return has been resolved. A collection confirmation records the handover; it does not mean that the refund decision has already been made.

We will explain the outcome of your return and how any refund will be made. If you disagree with a decision, or believe your collection has not been handled as agreed, contact customer care and ask for a review. Nothing in these collection arrangements limits your rights under consumer law.

Collections in Scotland South are made within 31 working days of a return being booked. To arrange a return, contact Halvard Home through the contact details shown on our website or in your order confirmation. Please have your order details available so we can find your purchase and explain the collection arrangements.

Tell us why you would like to return the item and whether it has been used, installed or damaged. This helps us arrange suitable handling and explain what you need to do before collection. Describing a fault does not limit your legal rights.

We will confirm whether collection is available from your address and explain any conditions that apply to your return. If a collection charge applies, we will explain it before you agree to the booking. We will not ask you to accept an unexplained charge.

Please check the collection address and contact details carefully when booking. Tell us about shared entrances, restricted parking, stairs, narrow access or other features that could affect collection. We use this information to help the collection team reach your property and handle the item safely.

Collection drivers in Scotland South give an arrival window of 151 minutes. Please make sure you can receive messages using the contact details supplied with your booking. If you have not received the arrival information, contact us rather than leaving the item outside.

The arrival window helps you plan for the visit, but traffic, weather and access problems can affect the driver’s arrival. If the collection team reports a disruption, we will let you know using your supplied contact details and explain how the booking will be handled.

An adult authorised to hand over the return must be present at the collection address. They should know which item is being collected and have access to the booking information. Please tell us if someone else will be acting on your behalf.

Keep the item indoors, secure and protected from damage while you wait for collection. Do not leave it on the pavement, in a shared passage or somewhere the driver cannot safely reach. The collection team cannot take responsibility for an unattended item.

Please remove personal belongings and prepare the return in line with the instructions we give you. Where relevant, remove personal information and disconnect linked accounts. If you are unsure how to prepare the item, ask us for guidance rather than attempting work that could be unsafe.

Do not attempt to disconnect anything that requires specialist attention. Tell us if the item remains connected or fixed in place so we can explain the available arrangements. Collection does not include disconnection or removal work unless we have expressly agreed this with you.

Use the original packaging if it is available and suitable. If it is missing or damaged, contact us for packing advice. We will explain what protection is needed for safe handling without asking you to conceal damage or cover information needed to identify the return.

Include any accessories or parts that we have asked you to send back. Keep anything we have told you not to return. If you are uncertain about what belongs with the item, contact us before packing it so that the return can be assessed properly.

Let us know if your access needs or personal circumstances affect the collection arrangements. We will discuss reasonable adjustments with you and explain what the collection team can provide. Please avoid including sensitive personal information unless it is needed to arrange appropriate support.

If you need to change or cancel the booking, contact Halvard Home as soon as you can. Changes must be confirmed by us. Please do not assume that leaving a message for the driver changes the arrangements recorded against your return.

The driver may decline collection if access is unsafe or the item has not been prepared as agreed. If this happens, contact us so we can understand the problem and discuss a suitable way forward. We will explain any proposed charge before arranging another collection.

Ask for confirmation that the item has been collected and keep it with your return correspondence. Collection confirms handover, not the outcome of any assessment. We will contact you about your refund or other agreed remedy after the return has been processed.

If a collection is missed or you have concerns about the driver’s conduct, contact us with the booking details and a description of what happened. We will investigate and explain the next steps. Nothing in these collection arrangements removes or restricts your statutory rights.

cell.item: POL-RET/North of England/Collections in this region

result.text:
If you are returning an item from an address in North of England, contact Halvard Home customer support to arrange a collection. We will explain whether collection is available for your return and confirm the information we need. Please do not arrange transport on our behalf unless we have agreed this with you.

Collections in North of England are made within 41 working days of a return being booked. Your booking confirmation will explain how we will contact you about the collection. Please check that the collection address and your contact details are correct, and tell us if anything needs changing.

When you book, please tell us about access to your address. This includes stairs, restricted parking, shared entrances or anything that could make collection difficult. If permission is needed to enter the building or use a loading area, please arrange this with the person responsible for the property.

Collection drivers in North of England give an arrival window of 121 minutes. We will explain how that window will be shared with you. Please make sure someone authorised to hand over the return is available at the address and can answer questions about access.

Tell customer support if you need help preparing for collection because of a disability or access requirement. We will discuss suitable arrangements with you and explain what the collection team can provide. Please do not assume that a request has been passed to the driver unless we have confirmed it.

Before collection, follow the preparation instructions we provide. The item should be safe to handle, with personal belongings removed and loose parts secured where appropriate. Do not attempt work that requires specialist knowledge. If you are unsure how to prepare the return safely, contact us rather than risk injury or damage.

If the item needs disconnecting, we will explain whose responsibility this is when arranging the return. Collection does not automatically include disconnection or work on your property. Tell us if there is a leak, damage or another condition that could make handling unsafe, so we can agree a suitable approach.
